text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh... *sniff*, uuu...
Can I really do this, I wonderrr...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't cry.
You're gonna make it to the legendary blade, right...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It all started a few hours ago—
while I was walking in front of the station.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You want to help Opera, but you don't have the confidence...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, apparently they're staging a new opera...
and it seems they need to do a lot of research for it.
So I offered to help out, but—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Now that I actually have the map in hand...
I'm getting worried if someone like me can even go to a place like this...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I was crying here all alone.
...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I said I'd just tag along, but...
to think I'd end up in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What is this interview about a "legendary sword"
even supposed to be in the first place...?!
choice_data_list: I ended up following you all the way here, though.
I ended up following you all the way here, though.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry...!
B-But, ...there are children looking forward to the play too, so~...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I can tell you have no intention
of backing down...
Ugh, let's just finish this quickly!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we set off in search of
the Legendary Sword, but—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a-aaaaah...! It's shaking, it's shaking-shaking!
It's so highhh... I'm so scaredddd!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't look down.
Keep your eyes forward and walk.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
How can you walk so fast...!?
Hieeeeee...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah...! My shoes are totally soaked~!
My butt and back are too...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Pull yourself together.
You decided you were going to see this through, didn't you!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... H-huh?
Is that over there...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Could this be the legendary—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, the interview went without a hitch!
Thank you so very much!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...That map barely served as a map at all,
did it? Opera O... honestly."
choice_data_list: Man, I really took the long way around...
I really took the long way around, huh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um-um, I'm so very sorryyy!
I've made you so, so tired..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to apologize for doing what you wanted.
...Well then.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But—... Oh, wait!
Please hold on for just a second...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A... "A tired body calls for Hachimii~♪"
as the commercial goes, so please, let me treat you—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No need.
I've already received your thanks in words.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But wait, that alone isn't... Ah!
How about something besides drinks~?
Like ice cream, or grilled carrots! And—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...It's really fine.
You're the one who worked so hard, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh, but...
Ayabe-san got a lot of them too...

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! I knew it was Doto-onee-chan!!
Are you getting ready for the play today too?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, it's the kids from the community club.
Opera O invited them to the play..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, hello, everyone.
We just finished getting ready for the play.
This big sister here helped us out...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I just followed along.
I didn't do anything.

text_block_list.name: Hot-Blooded Boy
text_block_list.text:
S-S-So... So cool~~!!?
Just like a superhero!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Girl
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister helped Doto-oneechan,
but she didn't brag at all! So cool!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a second...
choice_data_list: I know, right!? She's so cool!
I know, right?! It's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a second...
choice_data_list: I know, right!? She's so cool!
I know, right?! It's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Listen... I only did what anyone would have done, right?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: SO COOOOOL!!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Ah, geez...!
It's because you went and said something unnecessary...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega is surrounded by children,
casting a resentful glare in my direction.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me, you say...
choice_data_list: Alright, Operative Ayabe! On to the next location!
Alright, Operative Ayabe! Let's head to the next location!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
!!!
Good luck helping people, Big Sis--!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Are you used to that? That whole vibe?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like you could star in a certain someone's play.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Admire Vega murmured in half-exasperation,
I could only offer a wry smile on the walk back.
